values.note: Electric and water $40/night ($200/week), full hookup $50/night ($250/week); electric-only tent site $35. 5-person limit per site. Yearly and 'professional' (work/school) site rates by phone. The operator's page is footed 'Copyright © 2024' (read 2026-10-21); Campspot not read.

values.note: 'Reserve Your Spot Now!' links to Campspot. The operator sells yearly recreational and 'professional' sites as well but says 'WE DO NOT OFFER SEASONAL LOTS AND WE DO NOT HAVE CAMPSITES TO LIVE ON.'

Eggleston Road is curvy: 'We frequently accommodate up to 42' fifth wheels ... We do not recommend any of the larger Class A motorhomes trying to make the trip.' Trains run on both sides of the river and can be loud at night.

summary: Confirmed on the operator's page (footed 2024): $40 electric/water to $50 full hookup, water and sewer, camp store, Campspot booking; fees.checked corrected 2026 -> 2024 (the page's date). Not stated: electric amperage, site count (70 from the note, left), season, max rig length beyond 'up to 42' fifth wheels' and the Class A warning.
